_about: Building blocks of the colleague (saga/ai_say.py) - English. English has no formal address; variants only where needed.
label: {name} · AI
intro: I'm {name}, your server's AI. I only see what you can see; your question and matching excerpts from your pages, tasks and events go to {where}. I won't change anything or message anyone without your OK.
_intro.form: Intro card and bar (2515): English has no formal address - empty entries, the system text applies.
q.add_event: Shall I put “{title}” in your calendar?
q.add_task.plain: Shall I add a task for it?
q.add_event.plain: Shall I put it in your calendar?
alt.add_task: Shall I add a task “{task}” instead?
alt.add_event: Shall I put “{title}” in your calendar instead?
alt.add_task.plain: Shall I add a task instead?
alt.add_event.plain: Shall I put it in your calendar instead?
alt.fill_row: Shall I add it to “{page}” instead?
plan.head: Here's how I'd do it:
step.wait_reply: Wait for {person} to reply, until {deadline} at the latest.
start: On it. I'll get back to you when {person} replies – by {deadline} at the latest.
start.nodl: On it. I'll get back to you when {person} replies.
start.noone: On it. I'll get back to you when it's done.
wait: {person} replied. I'll read it once your device is online.
seen: {person} wrote in the chat – was that the reply?
fail.kein_zugriff: I no longer have access to “{target}”.
fail.kein_zugriff.notarget: I no longer have access to a page in the plan.
fail.konflikt: “{target}” was changed in the meantime – I didn't overwrite anything.
fail.konflikt.notarget: A page was changed in the meantime – I didn't overwrite anything.
fail.abgemeldet: You were signed out. The job is waiting for a new OK.
fail.recht: I'm no longer allowed to do this. The job is waiting.
fail.modell: The AI was unreachable for too long.
fail.budget: Today's quota is used up. I'll continue tomorrow.
fail.plan_geaendert: The plan was changed after the OK. I didn't carry it out.
oops.verdict_yes: That was my mistake: I took {person}'s reply as a yes.
oops.verdict_no: That was my mistake: I took {person}'s reply as a no.
cant.web: I can't search the web here.
undo: Undone: “{target}” is back as it was.
undo.n: Undone: {n} changes are back as they were.
undo.untitled: Undone: everything is back as it was.
ident.human: No. I'm {name}, an AI on your Saga server.
ident.owner.agent: No, this is {name}, an AI. The question came on {owner}'s behalf.
ident.feelings: I'm an AI and don't have feelings. What can I help you with?
ident.personal: I'm an AI – I don't have an age or a home.
ident.who_reads: Your question and matching excerpts from your pages, tasks and events go to {where}. Your admin can technically read along.
